title: Windshield Assembly — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of one windshield assembly, covering heating supply isolation, the sealant cut sequence and the frame protection that must be in place before the pane is lifted out.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove one windshield assembly for replacement, for frame inspection or for the sealing work described in the applicable service bulletins.
sections.job_setup_note: The pane is heavy and expensive and the frame is easily damaged by a slipped blade. Use the vacuum lifting frame and two people. Isolate the window heating and prove it dead before any connection is disturbed; the heating film terminals hold a charge for several seconds after isolation. Plan the work so that the aperture is not left open overnight without the temporary cover.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the window heating circuit breakers and attach the do-not-close tags. 2. WARNING: PROVE THE HEATING SUPPLY DEAD AT THE TERMINALS BEFORE YOU TOUCH THEM. THE FILM TERMINALS HOLD A CHARGE AFTER ISOLATION. 3. Remove the interior trim panel at the windshield. 4. Disconnect the heating film connections and identify them with tags. 5. Attach the vacuum lifting frame to the outer face and confirm the vacuum holds for one minute. 6. Cut the sealant bead around the pane with the sealant knife, keeping the blade angle away from the frame land. 7. CAUTION: DO NOT LEVER BETWEEN THE PANE AND THE FRAME. A MARK ON THE FRAME LAND BECOMES A CORROSION SITE UNDER THE NEW SEALANT. 8. Remove the retaining fasteners in the sequence shown in the figure and keep them in the parts tray. 9. Lift the pane clear with two people and put it in the transport frame. 10. Clean the remaining sealant from the frame land with the approved solvent. 11. Do a visual inspection of the frame land, the corner bracket and the spar cap and record the condition. 12. Install the temporary aperture cover if the installation does not follow immediately.
sections.close_out: Leave the heating circuit breakers open with the tags attached. Make sure the temporary cover is sealed against rain if the aircraft is outside. Record the removal, the pane part number and serial number, and the frame land condition in the aircraft technical log.

safety_precautions: Prove the heating supply dead at the terminals before you touch them.
Confirm the vacuum lifting frame holds for one minute before the fasteners are removed.
